latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Social Copy Generator Online — turn your video clips into ready-to-post social media copy.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB for fast AI-powered social copy and captions generation.
- Processes video content in 20–40 seconds via cloud GPUs; finished 1080p MP4 files ready to download.
- Automatically handles authentication and session setup (no manual API keys required).
- Supports multiple file types and batch processing; check credits and job status in-app.
- Includes robust error handling, with clear user guidance for authentication, file issues, credits, and exports.
